name: YQUP
title: YQUP Consulting
heading: AI is not the problem. Lack of clarity is.
summary: YQUP helps CEOs and boards see what is really happening in AI and agentic work, then decide what to do next.

sections.title: Where YQUP helps
sections.body: The work sits between strategy, operating model, governance, and practical delivery for organisations trying to move past AI theatre.

sections.title: Useful first conversation
sections.body: Start with a diagnostic conversation about ownership, incentives, governance, and where agentic systems should actually be trusted.

name: SNAXK
title: Judgement for long-running agents.
heading: Judgement for long-running agents.
summary: SNAXK is a practical research and product space for judgement, evaluation, and decision support in long-running agentic systems.

sections.title: Longer runs need better judgement
sections.body: As agents move from demos into ongoing work, judgement becomes the core control surface: what to continue, stop, escalate, or reframe.

sections.title: Built for practical systems
sections.body: The site is a home for experiments, notes, and tools that keep agentic work inspectable and useful.

name: My Agentic
title: My Agentic | URL homes for agentics
heading: A home for agentics that need a URL.
summary: My Agentic is a stable public address book for agentics: a place to give each one a URL, profile, owner, boundary, and status.

sections.title: Stable rooms
sections.body: Each agentic can have a clear public URL that humans, agents, and systems can refer back to.

sections.title: Readable profiles
sections.body: Each page can explain purpose, owner, permissions, boundaries, status, and escalation.

name: Chief Agentic Officer
title: Chief Agentic Officer | Board mandate for agentic work
heading: Chief Agentic Officer
summary: The board-level operating role for agentic AI: ownership, boundaries, assurance, value, and human judgement in one accountable mandate.
brief_title: Agentic AI needs an accountable operating owner.
brief: The Chief Agentic Officer turns board ambition into a governed operating system for agentic work.
brief_support: The role connects strategy, permissions, assurance, escalation, value, and human judgement so agentic systems can do useful work without becoming unowned automation.
work_title: From AI pilots to accountable capability.
tone_title: Firm boundaries. Useful autonomy. Visible judgement.
tone_body: The CAO is not a ceremonial title. It is the person or function that knows which agentic systems exist, what they can touch, when they stop, and how exceptions reach human judgement.
cadence_title: A weekly rhythm for agentic work.
cadence_body: Make agentic work legible to executives: current estate, trust boundaries, incidents, value, lessons, and decisions needed.
cta_title: Start with the systems already shaping work.
cta_body: Which agents, pilots, vendor promises, and shadow workflows already need ownership, boundaries, and review?
footer_tagline: Board-level ownership for agentic systems, governance, and operating cadence.

sections.title: Mandate
sections.heading: Turn board intent into operating authority.
sections.body: Clarify the problems agentic systems should solve, the risk appetite, the executive owner, and the decisions that remain human.

sections.title: Control
sections.heading: Make trust boundaries inspectable.
sections.body: Define permissions, stop conditions, escalation paths, evidence trails, spending limits, publishing rights, and review points before scale.

sections.title: Assurance
sections.heading: Show the work without slowing it down.
sections.body: Create a cadence for exceptions, outcomes, lessons, incidents, value, and the choices that need to travel from delivery back to the board.

operating_notes.title: Map the estate
operating_notes.body: Find the pilots, shadow workflows, vendor promises, automations, and agentic systems already influencing work.

operating_notes.title: Set the controls
operating_notes.body: Decide what agents may read, suggest, change, spend, publish, escalate, remember, or stop.

operating_notes.title: Report the judgement
operating_notes.body: Keep enough record of context, exceptions, outcomes, and decisions for leaders to inspect the work after the fact.

name: Agentic Leader Community
title: Agentic Leader Community
heading: Build, share, and evolve multi-agent crews together.
summary: A community space for leaders working with collaborative AI systems, multi-agent crews, and agentic operating models.

sections.title: A place for operators
sections.body: The community is for people building and governing AI-agent teams in the messy middle between experimentation and daily work.

sections.title: Shared practice
sections.body: Members compare patterns, lessons, operating constraints, and the small choices that make agentic work durable.

name: AI Operations Excellence
title: AIperations | AI operations that reach real work
heading: Turn AI pilots into operating outcomes.
summary: AIperations is a simple operating home for the practical discipline that turns AI demos into adopted, measurable, governed work.

sections.title: Name the outcome
sections.body: Start with the business result, baseline, owner, and decision rights before the prototype becomes another promising demo.

sections.title: Change the work
sections.body: AI only becomes operational when workflows, manager capacity, escalation, training, and review rhythms are redesigned around it.

name: Agentic Board
title: Empowering Agentic Board Members: Join Our Journey
heading: Empowering agentic board members.
summary: Agentic Board is a space for boards, advisors, and governance leaders adapting to AI-agent-enabled organisations.

sections.title: Agentic governance
sections.body: Boards need a language for AI agents that covers accountability, oversight, assurance, and operating risk.

sections.title: Board-ready practice
sections.body: The site gathers practical framing for directors and advisors who need to understand agentic systems without becoming tool tourists.

name: Dilijenz

summary: Dilijenz is preparing a focused public page for simpler board and diligence work.

sections.title: Diligence without drift
sections.body: Dilijenz keeps routine checks, evidence, and board materials organised so risks and gaps are easier to see.

sections.title: Clarity for both sides
sections.body: Investors and founders get a clearer shared surface for diligence and ongoing governance.

name: Syndesy
title: Syndesy

summary: Syndesy is being prepared as a focused space for connecting context, teams, and intelligent systems into practical operating flows.
note: The full site is being prepared.

sections.title: Connection with purpose
sections.body: Syndesy will focus on the connective tissue between people, systems, decisions, and agentic work.

sections.title: Useful before it is loud
sections.body: The first public version will stay practical, structured, and easy for both humans and agents to understand.

name: Orchistra
title: Orchistra | Shepherds of agentic systems
heading: Orchistra
summary: A living field map for agentic work: see what is moving, set useful boundaries, read the weak signals, and bring outcomes back into judgement.
brief_title: A clearer way to see agentic work in motion.
brief: Orchistra gives leaders a practical map of the agents, automations, vendors, prompts, permissions, and workarounds already moving through the business.
brief_support: It is less command centre, more attentive field craft: count what exists, set the hedges, watch for drift, and make sure useful work returns as records, decisions, and learning.
work_title: From loose agents to a visible operating field.
tone_title: Quiet enough to notice drift. Sharp enough to intervene.
tone_body: Agentic systems do not need theatre. They need a rhythm that makes motion legible: what changed, what crossed a boundary, what looks odd, and what needs human judgement before small drift becomes operational damage.
cadence_body: Before an organisation scales agentic work, leaders need a recurring rhythm for what exists, what changed, what crossed a boundary, and what needs judgement.
cta_title: Start with the work already moving.
cta_body: Which agents, automations, vendor workflows, and quiet experiments are already shaping decisions, and who is actually shepherding them?
footer_tagline: Field maps, operating cadence, and practical governance for agentic systems.

sections.title: Count
sections.heading: Know what is already moving.
sections.body: Map agents, automations, vendor tools, prompts, permissions, and side experiments before they become invisible infrastructure.

sections.title: Bound
sections.heading: Give autonomy a visible edge.
sections.body: Set what each system can read, suggest, change, publish, spend, escalate, stop, and remember.

sections.title: Return
sections.heading: Bring the work back into judgement.
sections.body: Turn agent activity into records, decisions, exceptions, lessons, and next actions that leaders can inspect.

operating_notes.title: Count the flock
operating_notes.body: Map the agents, automations, prompts, vendors, and side experiments already shaping work.

operating_notes.title: Set the hedges
operating_notes.body: Decide what each agent may read, suggest, change, publish, escalate, spend, or stop.

operating_notes.title: Read the field
operating_notes.body: Watch for weak signals, stale assumptions, repeated exceptions, and quiet workarounds.

operating_notes.title: Bring it home
operating_notes.body: Turn agentic activity into decisions, records, lessons, and a rhythm that leaders can inspect.
